Grain

Grain Patron Portal
With over 18.6 million bushels of licensed space, Legacy Coop has the storage and dumping capacity to handle your harvested crops.

In the last decade, we’ve brought two additional Greenfield facilities to help bring added value to our patrons.

Legacy Coop is positioned well on the BNSF and RCP&E railroad to ship wheat to the Pacific Northwest, Texas Gulf, and many interior destinations in the Midwest. Corn can be shipped by rail into any major market west of the Mississippi River and by truck throughout the Nebraska panhandle region.

We’re confident our knowledgeable team can help you with your marketing decision and help bring added value to your operation.
